title: Intermediate Studies in the Orbiting Head
summary: Teaches continuous circling of the flail head so one swing flows into the next with qi in the wrist.

title: Treatise on Chain Wraps and Binds
summary: Covers snaring limbs and weapons with the flail chain and freeing the chain from an opponent's grasp.

title: The Flail Fighter's Second Book
summary: Builds feints and linked swing combinations on the basics for students who already hold a first flail text.

title: Rules for Fighting Through a Shield Line
summary: Teaches how to loft hook and wedge a flail past a closed shield line into the men behind it.

title: Handbook of the Reversing Swing
summary: Trains the sudden reversal of a swinging head so a single swing lands twice or misleads the guard.

title: Canon of Pace Against Longer Reach
summary: Shows how a flail user closes with or denies the reach of spears swords and poles.

title: Studies in Chain Length and Distance
summary: Trains the user to pick the chain length and distance best suited to each swing and each opponent.

title: Book of the Rebound and Recovery Cut
summary: Teaches using rebounds from shields walls and blocks and turning the head's recovery into the next strike.
